newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen cautious at open, techs to guide.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen cautious at open, techs to guide.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to open cautiously and slightly lower on Wednesday, with investors continuing to focus on the technology sector following yesterday's sloppy performance.

"The market will open on the tentative side without conviction," Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co said. "The real concern is whether high-techs will selectively pick up." He said bonds would also dictate moves.
The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index was up 1.05 points at 844 and the long bond was trading down 7/32 at a 6.89 percent yield.
